properties.name: A Stop-hook export that failed once warns on every later turn of the session, and nothing keeps what the hook said; why the model declined /capture-session is not established
properties.statement:
Field log entry 2026-10-09 (hxm_program hub, VS Code 1.140, reflow2 0.80.0): /capture-session showed "Warning from Stop hook", then "Sorry, the model declined to complete this request"; no reflow2 call ran, and nobody kept either text.

MEASURED 2026-10-09 by replaying the hub's state with 0.80.0's tools/loop_nudge.py (--harness vscode) and the 0.80.0 binary, in a scratch project whose install receipt names docs/design/hxm_program.json, absent as in this repo since 2026-10-06:
- A hub write, then Stop: the hook returns decision block with a 1,054-character reason (the loop nudge, its door note and the export failure) AND systemMessage (402 characters: the export failed, No such file or directory).
- Every later Stop in the same session, including turns that wrote only to a member store: systemMessage alone, the same export failure, with no block and nothing fed back to the model.
- A session whose writes all went to a member store: the hub's hook prints nothing.
The outputs are valid JSON, so the report's candidate (c), malformed output, did not occur in the replay.

SO: if the two-day session wrote to the hub at any point, 0.80.0 shows that warning on every later turn. The export-path cause is fact:root-cause-the-export-path-has-no-owner-so-writes-the-hook-and-init-disagree-2026-10-06, fixed on main and not released. On a later turn the hook injected nothing, which argues against candidate (a), an injected continuation refused by the provider. That holds only for turns after the first nudge.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the session wrote to the hub before that turn (the report says that day's writes went to a member); whether VS Code shows systemMessage to the model; and why the model declined. Candidate (b), the prompt file plus a long compacted context, is untested and cannot be tested here. To tell them apart, on the work machine: capture the hook's stdout for one Stop, and retry /capture-session in a fresh chat with the hook disabled.

THE CLASS: what a hook returned is kept nowhere, so a turn it touched cannot be matched to what it said afterwards. The reporter's idea, a log of hook replies, is the missing instrument (dec:idea-the-stop-hook-keeps-a-log-of-what-it-returned).



RELEASED 2026-10-09 in v0.81.0: the export-path cause of the repeated warning (one recorded export path, read by writes, the Stop hook and init). On 0.81.0 the warning should not recur for that reason. Why the model declined /capture-session is still not established, and the hook still keeps no log of what it returned.
